Durotar Supply and Logistics

cheapest way to the rep and Merchant’s Favor for the DSL camp recipes, priced from the Horde PvP ruleset AH now
How it works: the DSL camp sits just outside the west gate of the Crossroads (The Barrens). Its vendors sell recipes for Merchant’s Favor (a currency), but the good ones also need reputation (Friendly = 3,000, Honored = 9,000).
1. Reputation = Craftsman’s Writs. Buy a writ on the AH plus the item it asks for, right-click the writ to accept it, and hand both to the customer. Journeyman +75, Expert +125, Artisan +200. Each different writ counts once per day, so do many different ones. Writs give no Favor.
2. Favor = Waylaid Crates. Buy an empty crate on the AH, right-click it, pick ONE bundle (e.g. 20 Copper Ore) and it seals with those mats inside. Hand the sealed crate to Dokimi for 5-30 Favor. Crates give no rep.
3. Your first crate ever starts the Shipping Label quest: +2,000 rep and +50 Favor - always do this first.
4. At Friendly, Kurvelk Shadowhoof sells a Forged Delivery Receipt (15 Favor): put it on an empty crate for +50 rep.

Step 1 - your first crate (+2,000 rep, +50 Favor)

Cheapest right now: buy Waylaid Crate: Apprentice Herbs (8.6s) and fill it with 20 Silverleaf (11s) = 19s total, level 10+. That alone takes you two thirds of the way to Friendly.
